rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you make an object straight.

example.english: This wire is bent; help me straighten it.
example.traditional: 呢條鐵線彎咗，幫我整直佢。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 tit3 sin3 waan1 zo2 bong1 ngo5 zing2 zik6 keoi5

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone straightens up by rising from a seated position.

example.english: You’ve been sitting so long—straighten up and take a walk.
example.traditional: 坐咗咁耐，你企起身行吓啦。
example.jyutping: zo6 zo2 gam3 noi6 nei5 kei5 hei2 san1 haang4 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when something itself becomes straight rather than when someone actively straightens it.

example.english: The plastic ruler began to straighten after soaking in hot water.
example.traditional: 條膠尺浸咗熱水之後，慢慢變直喇。
example.jyutping: tiu5 gaau1 cek3 zam3 zo2 jit6 seoi2 zi1 hau6 maan6 maan6 bin3 zik6 laa3
